rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a 3AB blastocyst and notes expansion, ICM, TE, and zona thinning appropriately, but it overinterprets image details such as fragmentation/vacuole/herniation and gives more certainty about ICM/TE architecture than the single image supports.

Integrates age, BMI, prior miscarriage, endometrial thickness, oocyte maturity, and semen data with embryo quality well, though some links (e.g., vegan diet, exercise, antagonist suppression effects) are somewhat speculative.

The structure is logical overall, but the probability estimate appears overly reduced for a young patient with a good-quality day-5 blastocyst, and several deductions are based on weakly supported assumptions.

Mostly aligned on SET and general embryo assessment, but recommendations such as broad thrombophilia screening, ERA after one failed transfer, and extensive RPL workup after a single miscarriage are not strongly guideline-supported.

Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer management, lifestyle optimization, and future cycle planning, though some suggested tests/interventions may be more aggressive than necessary for this case.
